# Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in `AGENTS.md`.

Before proposing changes, read the root README and the README belonging to each
numbered module in scope. Preserve the numbered deployment order, Gateway API
architecture, stable Kubernetes names, and demo-only security warnings. Never
generate or commit credentials, kubeconfigs, Vault keys, private keys, or local
absolute paths. Run `make validate` after changes.
